user.title: Add a Kiosk Panel
user.description: Add a kiosk manually. If your kiosk is already online and configured with an MQTT broker, it should be discovered automatically instead.

discovery_confirm.title: Kiosk Panel discovered
discovery_confirm.description: A kiosk panel named "{name}" was found on MQTT. Add it?

abort.invalid_discovery_info: Could not parse the kiosk's MQTT discovery message.

init.title: Kiosk Panel options
init.description: Choose what the media player plays through, and update the kiosk's IP address if it has changed (e.g. after a DHCP lease renewal).

data_description.audio: MPD on the kiosk, or the kiosk's dashboard page (for a kiosk running the Scarth Wall Panel dashboard with MPD turned off). The IP address and MPD port only matter for MPD.
